messages:
maya: Kicking off canary 5% for release v2.3.1 -> model-serving change + kv-cache tweaks. change window 21:00-21:30 UTC. tagging @ops-oncall @sanjay please watch latency + 5xxs.

deploy-bot: Canary started: v2.3.1 -> 5% traffic (eu-west). run id=deploy-1759256789. Logs: https://deploy.internal/r/1759256789

olivia: noted. i'll monitor dashboards (latency, 5xx, kvcache-misses).

ops-oncall: seeing small uptick in 502s on eu-west workers, +0.6% in last 5m. digging.

sanjay: can we pause traffic shift? @maya

maya: pausing canary. /deploy pause deploy-1759256789

deploy-bot: Pause accepted. Current traffic frozen at 5%. To rollback: /deploy rollback deploy-1759256789 --to v2.3.0

olivia: quick check: tail latency p99 jumped from 180ms -> 320ms correlated with kvcache-evict spikes in logs. adding stack traces to thread.

olivia: ```
[2026-03-23T21:05:12Z] kvcache: evict shard-12 due to mem pressure
[2026-03-23T21:05:13Z] upstream: 502 from model-instance-7
```

ops-oncall: impact is mostly inference-heavy routes (/generate-stream). user-facing errors ~0.4% but trending.

maya: recommend soft rollback in eu-west only. pin v2.3.0 for region and keep hosted elsewhere. @liz can you update release notes and patch doc? mention kvcache tuning.

liz: on it. will add: "Rollback: eu-west canary reverted to v2.3.0 due to kv-cache evictions causing 502s/p99 regressions." should we notify EU customers now?

sanjay: initiating regional rollback now. /deploy rollback deploy-1759256789 --to v2.3.0 --region eu-west

deploy-bot: Rollback started for eu-west. ETA ~2m. restoring kv-cache config. run id=rb-1759256789

ops-oncall: watching metrics. if error rate doesn't drop within 5m escalate to full cutoff.

olivia: metrics recovering: p99 back to 190ms, 502 rate back down to baseline.

maya: closing change window early. will keep canary paused until further tests. tagging @product to update release notes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary paused. Current traffic: 0% (eu-west pinned to v2.3.0). run id=deploy-1759256789. For reattempt, create new canary with updated kv-cache tuning.

liz: release notes updated and emailed to stakeholders. added rollback note and next steps for re-run.

olivia: filed follow-up ticket INF-3245 for kv-cache backpressure investigation. assigning to eng-runtime.

maya: thanks all. postmortem if needed after triage. closing thread.
